title: Cursed Textures By Codesmith
description: I tried to make these textures as terrible as possible. And also sometimes high resolution so they lag your game.
body:
A while ago, I had a terrible idea. Why not make a resource pack that was terrible and cursed?

At first, I was the only one who could witness its terrors, but now that I have a Modrinth account, I can visit the horror of this pack upon the WORLD!!!
